payments.label: Basic income support (BISS)
payments.condition: Paid on every eligible hectare of an active farmer; the same for every plan.

payments.label: Eco-scheme for arable land
payments.condition: Only if the whole farm meets the eco-scheme: at least 85% of its arable land covered by crops, plus the optional requirements it chooses.

payments.label: Coupled support for soybean
payments.condition: For each hectare of soybean declared to APIA; rate of the 2025 claim year.

payments.label: Coupled support for legumes grown for processing
payments.condition: For dry beans grown for processing, usually under a contract with a processor; rate of the 2025 claim year.

payments.label: Coupled support for sugar beet
payments.condition: For sugar beet delivered under a contract with a sugar factory; rate reported for the 2025 claim year (sources disagree: check the Order).

payments.label: Redistributive payment (CRISS)
payments.condition: Depends on the size of your farm, not on the plan; not included in the totals.
